note: BrowseComp-style MULTI-HOP research set. Facts were inherited from browsecomp-web-10 (verified 2026-11-17) and INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED by live web search on 2026-11-20 against primary sources: NobelPrize.org press release and scientific background, Google and Qolab announcements, PNAS laureate profile; Olympics.com Games page, medal table and ceremony reports; UNFCCC COP30 executive report, COP30 official site and UN News; FIFA.com match report, records and 'Chelsea confirm Maresca exit'. These are hand-written questions, not official benchmark items. Ground truth is in the key and hops fields; do not show the file to the model under test.
design: Every question hides the intermediate entity. The agent must discover fact A before it can formulate the search for fact B, and normally needs a third fact from a different domain. Each item records the required hops and an estimated minimum number of tool turns. A single search result page should not contain the whole answer.
system: You are a research assistant with web_search and web_fetch tools. You MUST use web_search to research the question and web_fetch to open and confirm the key sources before answering. Do not answer from memory alone. Several parts of each question depend on an entity you must first identify; work through them one at a time. Answer concisely and precisely, name the sources you used, and end with a short line: FINAL: <answer>

questions.q: A club won a 2025 football final 3-0 at a stadium in New Jersey. Its manager later left the club. Name the club, the player who scored the opening two goals in that final, and the manager.
hops: identify the 3-0 final at MetLife Stadium (13 Jul 2025) -> Chelsea vs Paris Saint-Germain
find who scored the first two goals -> Cole Palmer
find which Chelsea manager departed -> Enzo Maresca
sources: FIFA.com: final at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey, 13 Jul 2025
AP/CNN: Palmer scored twice, Joao Pedro once

questions.q: One of the three 2025 Nobel Physics laureates is Chief Scientist for Quantum Hardware at a big tech company's quantum AI division. Another is CTO of a Los Angeles quantum startup. Name the company, the startup, and the third laureate.
questions.key: Google (Google Quantum AI); Qolab; John Clarke
hops: job clue -> Michel H. Devoret -> Google Quantum AI
job clue -> John M. Martinis -> Qolab
the remaining laureate of the three -> John Clarke

questions.q: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics honoured experiments using a circuit element named after a physicist. One laureate pioneered an ultrasensitive detector based on the same physics. Name the element and that laureate.
hops: identify the circuit element in the prize-winning work -> Josephson junction
find which laureate pioneered the related detector -> John Clarke (SQUID)

questions.q: At a Winter Olympics where ski mountaineering made its debut, the cauldron in the larger host city was lit by two athletes. Name those two athletes, the country that topped the medal table, and its gold medal count.
questions.key: Deborah Compagnoni and Alberto Tomba; Norway; 18 gold
hops: debut sport -> Milano Cortina 2026
find the Milan cauldron lighters -> Compagnoni and Tomba
find the medal-table winner and its gold count -> Norway, 18
sources: Olympics.com Milano Cortina 2026: opening at San Siro in the larger host city

questions.q: A 2025 climate summit in the Amazon launched a mission named after the city where it was held, and its final text referenced only one earlier COP decision. Name the mission, the president of the 2025 summit, and the year of the earlier decision.

president -> Andre Correa do Lago
the sole referenced decision -> COP28 UAE Consensus, adopted 2023 in Dubai

hops: finance pledge -> COP30, Belem, Nov 2025 -> following year = 2026
2026 Winter Olympics medal table -> Norway, 18 gold, 41 total
